ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% high-intensity white pixels vs 25% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white central field; low-intensity black pigmentation is concentrated in a solid band along the trailing edge, a dense vertical splotch at the midline/notch base, and sparse focal circular spots on the medial right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression at the center with a depth approximately 1/8th of the total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous micro-serration across the entire trailing edge boundary, displaying high-frequency, low-amplitude pixel variations (peaks and valleys) against the background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge of both lobes, terminating in sharp distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of multiple small, dark circular pixel clusters scattered on the white field of the right lobe lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Parallel dark linear markings (rake marks) observed descending from the upper margin of the right lobe into the white region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible yellowish-tan growth or protrusion at the extreme distal tip of the right lobe; minor irregular notches on the distal margin of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive dark vertical column of pigmentation at the central junction between the peduncle and the fluke lobes.
